## Description

Combine directional momentum with futures curve/roll-yield signals to select commodity contracts.

## Where it may fit

Sustained commodity trends where curve structure provides useful carry information.

## Vehicles

CTA and commodity futures funds.

## Required data

Multiple futures maturities, settlements, contract rolls, collateral yields, returns and volatility.

## Caveats

Continuous-contract construction and roll implementation can materially change backtests.
